extraction.Name: Frank DuCharme
extraction.Recorded patent: On February 22, 1920, Richard Jones recorded the patent.
extraction.Buyer: DuCharme and wife mortgaged the SE/4 of Section 10 to W. S. Slaughter for $1500; DuCharme and wife mortgaged the Northeast to Slaughter for $1500; on November 10, 1928, DuCharme and wife conveyed the Northeast quarter to Alice Hettinger for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Tax certificate for the year 1925 was issued against the Southeast quarter and subsequent taxes are unpaid.
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612802 issued; East half of Section 10, township 41, north of range 26; receipt signed by allottee February 14, 1918; patent recorded by Richard Jones February 22, 1920; mortgage on SE/4 to W. S. Slaughter for $1500 dated November 19, 1920; mortgage on NE/4 to Slaughter for $1500 also dated November 19, 1920; NE/4 conveyed to Alice Hettinger November 10, 1928; tax certificate issued 1925 against SE/4, subsequent taxes unpaid; no other liens or judgments appear; S.D. 19929 referenced
